worker.name: caption-worker
worker.realization: media/worker-vlm/uv.lock (mlx-vlm 0.6.17 and mlx 0.32.2, MIT; huggingface-hub, numpy, pillow, jinja2), installed locally into media/worker-vlm/.venv with CPython 3.13.11 on Apple M3 Max. Forces HF_HUB_OFFLINE and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE on and reports them. Not a project-owned container. Output authority: Draft.

model.localPath: tmp/models/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct (not committed; fetched 2026-09-02 with huggingface_hub at the pinned revision)
model.note: The request file carries the digest of every model file the worker reads; the two shard digests equal the repository's LFS digests for the revision. The worker verifies all of them before loading and refuses an unlisted weight file or an index naming one.

note: Two consecutive worker runs over the same frames produced byte-identical outcomes (greedy decoding, seed 0). The declared pixel limits (16384 to 65536) differ from the model's preprocessor defaults, and the processor's grid for every frame (6x12 patches of 16 px = 18432 px) sits inside them; that is the evidence the limits were applied. The three extents sample the three declared flat-colour shots; the model described them as a solid red background, a solid green screen, and a uniform blue colour. That is a proposal about these frames under this recipe, not ground truth about anything. Ordinary CI replays this outcome; the live court runs the worker only when media/worker-vlm/.venv and the verified weights already exist and never installs or downloads either.
